描述_EN: the wide-sleeved belted over-robe was a typical dress of the time. his hat has a depiction of a small bird, probably an indication that he was charged with the duties of hunting activities of the imperial family. it was made using moulds and the lead glaze common in china from the late 6th century. this glazed earthenware figure is of a state official wearing a green robe.
描述_ZN: 宽袖束腰长袍是当时的一种典型服饰。 他的帽子上有一只小鸟的图案，可能表明他负责皇室的狩猎活动的职责。 它是用模具和6世纪末中国常见的铅釉制作的。 这个釉面陶俑是一个身穿绿色长袍的国家官员。
